div.style: color: rgb(84, 62, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Stop and reap owned gameplay process
Classify latest checkpoint and matching exit evidence

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;
color: rgb(89, 53, 63) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Block for operator reconciliation; exit 2
Provider, quota, storage, native failure,
uncertain outcome or unclassified exit
Preserve pending actions and original cutoff

div.style: color: rgb(67, 59, 83) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Capture immutable incident checkpoint and source
Reuse this baseline after rejection or restart

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Time remains before original cutoff
and no stop request?

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Incident repair budget available
and repair account unblocked?

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Persist attempt and audit identity
Launch configured repair command with prompt
Default attempt limit: 30 minutes, capped by cutoff

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Diagnose source, logs and available native evidence
Preserve session, pending and fairness
Repair agent must not launch gameplay

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p: Code change needed?

div.style: color: rgb(67, 59, 83) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Evidence-backed operational reconciliation
Source identity and HEAD unchanged
Pending and reservations remain for controller verification

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Implement focused fix and regression tests
Run focused and full tests
Keep normal walking, mining, reach and 1x speed

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Commit and push focused repair branch
Open or update pull request

div.style: color: rgb(67, 59, 83) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Independent review of exact PR head
GitHub approval or separate-agent source artifact

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Checks pass and exact-head review approves
with no outstanding changes requested?

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Merge without bypassing branch rules
Synchronize clean local HEAD and origin/main
Also synchronize fork/main if configured

div.style: color: rgb(67, 59, 83) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Write structured result with concrete evidence
Code and operational claims have distinct requirements

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Supervisor validates checkpoint and report
Preserve pending, attempt, plans, reservations,
background commitments, outcomes and failure budgets

div.style: color: rgb(67, 59, 83) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
For code: independently verify merged PR, review,
checks, exact commit, clean tree and remote main tips
Run full pytest or validate exact prevalidation artifact

div.style: color: rgb(67, 59, 83) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Recheck unchanged result bytes and source revision
Record source segment and durable acceptance event

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p: Repair accepted and audit durable?

div.style: color: rgb(84, 62, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Keep gameplay stopped; record rejected attempt
Exponential backoff capped at 15 minutes
Default budget: 3 attempts per incident

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Repair account quota exhausted
or incident attempt budget spent?

div.style: color: rgb(46, 72, 53) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Clear accepted repair-required gate
Keep original world, checkpoint and cutoff
Only supervisor may resume gameplay

div.style: color: rgb(61, 78, 70) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Stop and reap owned child processes
Preserve world, checkpoint and original cutoff

div.style: color: rgb(61, 78, 70) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Original cutoff reached
or stop requested?
